decathlon.com.py: 58. The gap: form labels.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 120 form controls have no label.

Apply this: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.

cng.edu: 51. The gap: ARIA roles.

Every external link that was checked answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents.

Takeaway: Use native HTML elements first. When you use ARIA roles, nest them the way the role requires.

co.computrabajo.com: 62. The gap: the https redirect.

Every external link that was checked answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But plain http serves the site without redirecting.

Apply this: Redirect every http request to https with one permanent 301, then add HSTS.

transavia.com: 68. The gap: tap targets.

Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But all touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space.

Carry this forward: Make every link and button at least 24 by 24 px, with space between them.
